{"path":"/results/10_feb_melting/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/task/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_trial_3/in.lammps","content":"# LAMMPS Input Script for Melting Silicon

units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

read_data silicon.data

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Si.sw Si

# Replicate the structure
replicate 3 3 3

# Define settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 5

timestep 0.001  # 1 fs timestep

# Equilibration and heating
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density

# NPT ensemble for heating
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 1.0 iso 0.0 0.0 5.0
run 100000  # 100 ps heating

# Equilibration at 2500K
unfix 1
fix 2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 1.0 iso 0.0 0.0 5.0
run 500000  # 500 ps equilibration

# Output MSD for diffusion calculation
compute msd all msd
fix 3 all ave/time 100 1 100 c_msd[4] file msd.txt mode vector

# End of script"}
